cohort_gate: both stock controls attempted; at least one bound exact directed literal-boundary success; freeze cohort enumeration only after this gate

protocol.diagnostics: midpoint for every selected directed pair; reverse first boundary request without changing lanes (wrong-direction)
protocol.order: distinct-edge first, then source segment/node/lane, destination segment/node/lane; first 128 boundary requests
protocol.prediction: direction-compatible candidates, not predicted native successes; all finite misses remain Unknown
protocol.rule: source travels away from its outside node; destination towards its outside node; swap Forward/Backward for segment Invert
protocol.scope: sampled_native_lane_paths_at_opening; file identity, not memory attestation or strict no-mods

stock_rule: first two builtin corpus filenames lexicographically with metadata incoming/outgoing train > 0; no replacement after native inspection
